findings.root_cause: The hash-preserved projected-lineup v1 validator used a raw prefix check rather than canonical typed date validation.
findings.affected_scope: Standalone downstream validation of attacker-rehashed noncanonical projected-lineup records.
findings.repair: A versioned v2 wrapper canonicalizes the complete date before invoking the preserved v1 validator.
findings.regression_proof: Sealed and noncanonical date mutation tests fail after recomputing the record hash.

findings.root_cause: The hash-preserved opportunity v1 replay builder enforced timing, but its standalone validator did not independently recheck assembly time or prior-game chronology.
findings.affected_scope: Downstream consumers presented with an independently rehashed opportunity snapshot.
findings.repair: A versioned v2 wrapper independently validates canonical dates, assembly time, and every declared prior-game date.
findings.regression_proof: Late assembly and same-day prior-history mutations fail after recomputing the snapshot hash.

findings.root_cause: Forward pitcher context v1 discarded official home and away team IDs at the schedule parser boundary.
findings.affected_scope: Any batter-side matchup consumer attempting to prove which probable pitcher opposes which team.
findings.repair: Forward pitcher context v2 retains official team IDs and names, pitcher IDs, raw payload hash, target identity, and T-4 chronology.
findings.regression_proof: Missing or swapped team identity cannot reach the matchup feature bundle; the source-parser test proves IDs are retained.
